reuse_decision: Any future P3.17 implementation should extend src/second_brain/handoff.py and compose existing working_set Active State Capsule, worker_protocol bounded context-handoff, ledger/telemetry identity and hash primitives, backup integrity checks, and thin harness adapters. Do not create a second handoff registry, parallel context store, or duplicate worker-protocol system. Define one bounded versioned artifact schema that preserves the required state, carries repository/start-state and evidence identities, supports deterministic write/readback, and is consumed through thin cross-harness transport. Prove at least one current OMP-primary source/target handoff and objective readback before any P3.17_PROVEN claim. Preserve P3.1-P3.16 and Lean HOLD_SHADOW; do not begin P4.
smallest_genuine_missing_seam: No current cross-harness consumer and no lossless/bounded readback contract: handoff.py can write a basic Markdown file, but no OMP/other adapter transports that canonical artifact to another harness and verifies that the objective, completed/verified state, decisions, blockers, repository/evidence references, and next action survive without transcript replay. The smallest complete P3.17 seam is therefore a standardized bounded handoff artifact/readback path wired through at least one real cross-harness pair, with current OMP-primary dogfood and honest token/context measurements.
